payload.summary: mode-home loading contract enumerates its thirteen routes by hand, so the next standalone home can ship with no loading coverage
payload.detail: MODE_HOME_LOADING_ROUTES in tests/mode-home-loading-contract.test.ts is a hand-written thirteen-entry array. It currently matches standaloneModeHomePaths (src/lib/search-route-ownership.ts) exactly - the mismatch that let medications, calculators and dictionary ship without loading.tsx was ledger #6K9YGQ and is now fixed - but nothing keeps the two lists in step, so the next standalone mode home added will silently have no loading coverage and CI will not notice. Fix: derive the test's route list from standaloneModeHomePaths instead of hand-writing it.
